about.title: Arco Chemicals
about.intro: An Egyptian manufacturer of agricultural pesticides and fertilizers, focused on practical relationships with partners across the agricultural sector.
about.missionText: To provide agricultural products and communicate clearly with customers, with support and coordination through our team.
about.productsText: We manufacture agricultural pesticides and fertilizers. Contact us for approved, available information about each product.
about.workText: Business dealings are handled through our office in Smouha, Alexandria. We coordinate supply and delivery across governorates.
about.supportText: Customers can contact our agricultural engineers for support and questions, whether product-related or about another agricultural topic.

privacy.title: Information we collect
privacy.body: When you use the contact form, we may collect your name, email address or phone number, message, selected product, optional country, and the language and time of your inquiry. Arco does not ask for information that is unnecessary to respond.

privacy.title: How we use information
privacy.body: We use your information to respond to inquiries, coordinate product orders or support, and follow up with you. The website may open WhatsApp with a pre-filled message for you to send.

privacy.title: Storage and retention
privacy.body: The company stores inquiries for as long as needed to respond and manage the business relationship, then deletes them or restricts access when there is no longer a practical or legal need.

privacy.title: Sharing and third-party services
privacy.body: We do not sell personal information. If you choose to continue your message through WhatsApp, you use a service provided by WhatsApp, part of Meta, under its own terms and policies. Information processed by WhatsApp is subject to its policies.

privacy.title: Cookies and analytics
privacy.body: The website currently does not use analytics tools or advertising cookies. The technical infrastructure may use cookies necessary to deliver and secure the website.

privacy.title: Your requests and rights
privacy.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your inquiry information, or ask how it is used, by contacting us at the phone or WhatsApp number shown on the website. We will review requests in accordance with applicable law.

privacy.title: Children
privacy.body: This website and its content are intended for customers and professionals in the agricultural sector, not children. We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children.

privacy.title: Changes and governing law
privacy.body: We may update this policy when necessary; the last-updated date appears at the top of the page. This policy is governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

privacy.title: Contact
privacy.body: For privacy questions, contact Arco Chemicals by phone or WhatsApp at 010 80021195. Business dealings are handled through our office in Smouha, Alexandria.

terms.title: Using the website
terms.body: This website introduces Arco Chemicals and its products and helps users make inquiries. You agree to use it lawfully and not disrupt it, attempt unauthorized access, or submit misleading or harmful content.

terms.title: Product information
terms.body: Published information is for general guidance and may change or omit details. It is not agricultural advice and does not replace the product label or official instructions. Before use, read the product label, follow local laws and regulations, and consult an agricultural specialist.

terms.title: Orders and inquiries
terms.body: The company handles inquiries to respond and coordinate product orders or support. Submitting an inquiry does not create a sales contract or guarantee product availability, price, or delivery timing. Order and supply details are coordinated and confirmed separately through the company office in Smouha.

terms.title: Intellectual property
terms.body: Unless stated otherwise, the company name, logos, and website content are owned by or used with permission by Arco Chemicals. They may not be copied or reused commercially without prior permission.

terms.title: Limitation of liability
terms.body: We take reasonable care in preparing the website, but do not guarantee uninterrupted access, freedom from errors, or that all information will always be complete. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for loss resulting from relying on website information without checking the product label or consulting a specialist or competent authority.

terms.title: External links and services
terms.body: The website may link to maps, social platforms, or other external services for convenience. Arco does not control third-party content or policies; use of those services is subject to their terms.

terms.title: Changes, governing law, and jurisdiction
terms.body: We may update these terms when necessary; the last-updated date appears at the top of the page. These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. The competent courts in Alexandria, Egypt have jurisdiction, subject to mandatory rules on jurisdiction.

terms.title: Contact
terms.body: For questions about these terms, contact Arco Chemicals by phone or WhatsApp at 010 80021195.
